reference_consistency_warnings.status: reference cleanup required; grammar follows latest settled rule
reference_consistency_warnings.detail: The main Built-in Metadata Parsing section requires complete @co.* names to match the predefined built-in registry and makes an unregistered @co.* name a parse error, while Appendix C.7.1 still contains the older wording that an unhandled built-in metadata form may be silently ignored. The grammar keeps the generic annotation shape from Appendix C but adds the explicit predefined registry/parser-check policy from the latest main-section decision. Unknown fields of a known form remain collected and preserved.

The Extension Declarations section defines @co.dap.class methods in co.lang.extension and maps self to the fortype class/type context, while the later Reserved words paragraph describes self only in methods declared by co.lang.class. The grammar follows the extension rule and permits self in target-bound extension class methods.

The Built-in Directives table's explanatory note mentions @co.dap.overload, but @co.dap.overload is not an entry in the table's predefined ANNOTATION registry column. Under the strict registry rule it is therefore not registered by this grammar; add it to the table explicitly if it is intended to be a built-in form.

The forall sections describe forall as a polymorphic type-expression binder, while a Rank-2 return example still contains a forall-prefixed anonymous function literal. The grammar retains the pre-existing anonymous-function forall form and treats forall as contextual rather than hard-reserved.

notes: The latest project model uses src/appl.fol or src/component.fol as the sole primary src surface. Legacy src/library.fol, src/export.fol, srclib/* source-library roots, co.lang.library, and the special co.lang.package/package.fol model are absent from this grammar.

All project-local component surfaces use _ co.lang.component. application/native/dynamicvmrt are projected component kinds; packaged uses the export selector; operators contains co.lang.operator declarations only. Filesystem role supplies the component kind and structural validation context.
components/operators/component.fol now uses the common component-surface-file parser root. There is no separate operator-source-file parser root in the consolidated grammar.
The former system and ffi component/library capability kinds are merged into native. FFI remains functionality within the native capability, not a separate project kind.

co.lang.extension now has an explicit active declaration production with mandatory ->(fortype=Type) targeting. It adds behavior without creating a subtype or changing the target inheritance hierarchy.
value.to(TargetType) uses the existing postfix member-call grammar; no dedicated cast production was added.

Built-in @co.* metadata application retains the single generic annotation production, but the parser is required to match the complete built-in name against the predefined metadata registry. The registry closes form names, not fields: fields of a known form remain generically collected and preserved.
Custom metadata names outside co.* remain syntactically generic but must resolve through the symbol table to a user-defined annotation or decorator; custom directives/pragmas are not available.

Parameterized co.lang.type constructors continue to use direct type-argument-list syntax such as Box(co.lang.type); annotation-based generic declarations continue to be representable through the arrow generic-argument form.
Appendix C EBNF blocks remain textually identical to their corresponding productions in the consolidated grammar. Separate reference_consistency_warnings record prose that still needs cleanup.
